text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! It appears your training<n>regimen
is going swimmingly!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I came to check in on things, but... color<n>
me impressed! I see you've been<n>
supporting your trainee with panache!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ♪ Keep up the good work and<n>watch
your trainee grow stronger over<n>time!
